environment:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: proposed visual-polish mockup for the current Unity version of Deep Feast.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a fresh gameplay screenshot from the actual current Unity macOS player, commit 5f75e02. Input image 2 is a STYLE/IDENTITY REFERENCE: its actual Unity species gallery, showing the six already-installed painted fish alongside the remaining simpler species.
Repaint only the game's visual presentation into a cohesive professionally illustrated 2D arcade underwater scene. Keep the existing terrain/sand ridge silhouette, camera framing, current character centers, facing directions and relative character sizes EXACTLY. Keep the turquoise/gold hero small near 50% horizontal, 48% vertical, not a giant promo mascot. Do not move or invent fish. Maintain the recognizable installed turquoise player, orange clownfish, blue/yellow-tail tang, yellow angelfish, tan puffer and slate shark. Bring the other existing fish's rendering into the same restrained painted style.
Main improvement: richer depth and a coherent lighting/material language, not extra gameplay clutter. Replace flat angular distant silhouette layers with subtly rounded layered reef outcrops and broad-leaf kelp shapes, progressively desaturated and blurred with distance. Deep navy silhouettes at the edges, a clear luminous teal swimming corridor. Soft broken sun shafts, fine restrained suspended particles. On the same right-hand sand slope, warm ivory sand with low-contrast organic ripples and sparing soft caustic patches rather than a dense white net; a subtle contact-shadow lip at the terrain edge. Repaint the existing foreground coral and rocks with consistent soft 2D volume, navy contours, peach/pink branch coral, natural rounded purple tube sponges, textured orange brain coral and cool slate rocks partly buried in the sand. Keep exactly the existing object locations and approximate bounds. No excessive bloom, giant glows, decorative junk or dense coral over the playable corridor. No photorealism, no plastic 3D.
HUD is invariant: retain '0' score top-left, compact 'HUNTER' / 'next: PREDATOR' panel and bar at top center, three small player-fish lives top-right, 'DEPTH 95 m' and 'DASH' bottom-left, round muted-audio control bottom-right. Same text, locations and compact layout as image 1. No new widgets or headings, no comparison labels, no watermark.
Output one clean 16:9 landscape gameplay screenshot, ideally 1536x864. This is a review concept, not a finished game screenshot; preserve the current implementation's identities and layout so the improvements are directly comparable.
remainingSpecies:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: review-only completion of the six fish that still use procedural art in the current Unity game Deep Feast.
Input image 1 is an IDENTITY/LAYOUT reference: actual Unity screenshots of the six remaining species, cropped from the freshly rebuilt commit 5f75e02. Input image 2 is a STYLE reference: the actual Unity gallery, whose clownfish, tang, angelfish, puffer, shark and turquoise player are already painted. Match those painted species' polished 2D look so all twelve fish feel made by the same artist.
Generate exactly six isolated side-view fish, all facing RIGHT, in a three-column, two-row landscape grid. Ideally 1536x1024. Keep their original relative silhouette proportions, recognizable palettes and markings, and roughly 74% of the cell width. Each whole tail/fins visible with generous margins. No text, no labels, no outlines around cells, no UI, no scenery, no bubbles, no props, no extra fish. Solid deep navy background #092c43.
Style: polished 2D hand-painted arcade sprites, crisp navy contour, restrained rounded cel shading, fine ribbed translucent fins, subtle top highlights and a little visible scale texture, expressive clean eyes matched to the installed fish. Avoid flat gradient ellipses, giant eyes on every species, excessive gloss, realistic photography or plastic 3D.
Top left MINNOW: slim silver/ice-blue small fish with a narrow pale lateral stripe, darker blue dorsal side, pale belly, forked translucent icy-blue tail; curious small face. It must remain a slim minnow, not a fat tropical fish.
Top middle PARROTFISH: oval jade/sea-green body, scalloped teal scales, pink-purple beak/cheek, magenta-pink dorsal and tail fins; a cheerful rounded parrotfish beak, brighter expressive face.
Top right SNAPPER: oval warm coral-red/pink body with a deeper red back and cream-pink belly, rose fins, distinct clean dorsal fin, confident broad fish profile, subtle scale arcs.
Bottom left BARRACUDA: unmistakably long narrow silver-blue predatory body, dark short vertical bars along the upper flank, thin angular pointed snout with a subtle projecting jaw and tiny teeth, a small sharp eye, forked slate tail. Preserve its skinny fast silhouette; do not make it a shark or a round fish.
Bottom middle GROUPER: stocky broad brown/tan fish with mottled dark brown blotches, cream belly, wide fan tail and rounded brown dorsal/pectoral fins, fuller cheek and characteristic heavy lower lip. Match the charm and rendering quality of the installed puffer without becoming a puffer.
Bottom right TUNA: strong streamlined slate/cobalt-blue torpedo body, darker back and silver-white belly, narrow tail peduncle with a pronounced crescent tail, small yellow-gold finlets, restrained confident eye. Preserve a tuna silhouette, not a shark.
This is a proposed improvement to existing installed species, not a new cast.
bitePoses:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: review-only fish pose/animation art proposal for the current Unity Deep Feast game.
Input image 1 is the edit/pose reference: actual current Unity rendered player and clownfish, normal and forced bite poses, cropped from the game gallery at commit 5f75e02. Input image 2 is the installed painted-fish style reference.
Produce a polished four-frame review sheet, exactly two columns by two rows, landscape 8:5, ideally 1536x960. Top row turquoise PLAYER, bottom row orange CLOWNFISH. Left column swimming/relaxed, right column mid-CHOMP with a visibly articulated jaw. All four full-body fish face RIGHT, heads and tails fully visible, same body lengths within each row, generous margins. No text, no labels, no grid lines, no scenery, no new objects. Solid deep navy background #092c43.
Keep the exact installed identities: turquoise/gold player with cream belly, yellow-gold dorsal/pectoral/tail fins, golden side stripe, three small white flank spots, thin bright edge highlight; clownfish vivid orange with precisely three white bands edged in navy, orange scalloped fins. Same clean navy-contour hand-painted 2D style, fine fin rays and restrained rounded highlights as the installed fish; not a redesign into other species.
The improvement is ANATOMY OF THE BITE and natural expression. Current bites merely paint a dark oval on the unchanged snout; replace that with a convincing jaw opening: upper snout lifts slightly, lower jaw swings down/out, the mouth cavity occupies the actual gap between jaws, lower jaw has a lit cream/orange rim and visible restrained pink tongue. Cheek and lips deform smoothly with the open mouth. The silhouette MUST visibly change in right-column bite frames. Do not paste a black circle or lipstick-like blob onto a closed head. No giant teeth, no gore.
Relaxed left frames: friendly focused eye, small integrated smile, stable tail/body overlap with no seam. Chomp right frames: active focused gaze following the food ahead, slightly squashed body and energized fin/tail pose, a clear eye lid that fits the painted eye rather than a flat mismatched color patch. Player's expression must remain eager and heroic rather than sinister. The closed-to-open poses should look usable as keys for an eventual short bite animation, not just changes in mouth color.
Constraints: preserve original fish palette, stripe/band placement, proportions and body size. This is a pose-polish proposal for already-installed artwork.
